item.description: • Changed: **Bug Fixes** • Changed: Settlement now counts both completed and failed tasks; final completion is sent only after all tasks are settled and failure events are handled. • Changed: **New Features** • Changed: Failure events are intercepted and routed to the settlement handler so failed tasks update progress, counts, and finalization. • Changed: **Documentation** • Changed: Multi-task coordination docs updated to explain settled vs completed and the need to handle both success and failure events. • Changed: **Tests** • Changed: Expanded tests covering completion, failure, mixed settlements, delivery semantics, and final_completion emission. • Changed: **Chores** • Changed: Reduced logging verbosity across several background processing paths. • Changed: <!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit. • Changed: [x] 43 tests pass across all 4 test files (tracking, completion, forwarder, orchestrator) • Changed: [x] `test_realistic_59_tasks_with_15_failures` reproduces the exact 44/59 scenario • Changed: [x] Mixed complete/fail, all-fail, partial settlement, edge cases all covered • Changed: [x] New `test_message_forwarder. • Changed: <!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit. • Changed: `MessageForwarder` now intercepts `TASK_FAILED` for tracked tasks (same as `TASK_COMPLETED`), routing them to `TaskCompletionHandler. • Changed: `TaskTrackingHelper` tracks `failed_tasks` alongside `completed_tasks`; settlement = completed + failed >= total • Changed: `TaskCompletionHandler. • Changed: Updated `multi-task-coordination/SKILL. • Changed: **Root cause:** When tasks failed, `MessageForwarder` forwarded `TASK_FAILED` to the client unhandled.
